subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Now a days students are i. for the better future of i. in near future getting busy ii. passing their time on Facebook ii. indifferent to their studies (b) As a result, they cannot iii. cut a good figure in the iii. their children are worried (c) Their parents who struggle examination about the matter (d) The students are now seen iv. with trifling matters and are iv. doing nothing beneficial (e) Thus, they waste their seen v. which is expected by the valuable time v. unawarely and fall in problems parents
guide_solution: Matching (a) Nowadays students are getting busy with trifling matters and are seen indifferent to their studies. (b) As a result, they cannot cut a good figure in the exam which is expected by the parents. (c) Their parents who struggle for the better future of their children are worried about the matter. (d) The students are now seen passing their time on Facebook doing nothing beneficial. (e) Thus they waste their valuable time unaware and fall in problems in near future.
